entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Joseph Shen Bin is a Chinese Catholic prelate who has served as Bishop of Shanghai since 2023 and as president of the Chinese Catholic Patriotic Association since 2022. He was Bishop of Haimen from 2010 to 2023.
